name: viewforge-3d-local
description: A separate, local-venv ViewForge 3D workbench for Codex with immutable modeling, rendering, rigging, and topology-preserving surface smoothing tools.

interface.shortDescription: Run ViewForge from a private local venv, including surface smoothing.
interface.longDescription: A side-by-side local edition of ViewForge 3D for Codex. It uses a repository-owned Python 3.11 virtual environment and separate local state, keeps the ChatGPT/Tunnel edition unchanged, exposes immutable modeling and rendering workflows, and adds bounded topology-preserving Blender surface smoothing plus direct local artifact paths.
defaultPrompt: Use $viewforge-3d-local:viewforge-3d-router to choose a private local 3D workflow.
Smooth an approved Blend or GLB with smooth_model_surface, then inspect its QA and render.
Use get_local_artifact_path after a job so local desktop tools can open its output.
